goals.objective: Bootstrap T0 for the approved C8 SMS refactor without editing product files. Create external worktree D:/Code/Git/ImmortalWrt-C8-660-SMS-Refactor on branch codex/sms-forward-refactor from HEAD f97b925d9808ee34b3660ae122df024ebaa31bdd, apply C:/Users/Administrator/AppData/Local/Temp/c8-sms-user-worktree.patch, and prove a clean reproducible baseline matching exactly the 11 tracked modifications in the main workspace. Stop when the exact branch and HEAD exist, the snapshot SHA256 is 543ab772ad16f879dfdcabe3a5963ab3cc7c1aa5ba2dd47ea0799dc5818b4d05 and applies, external status has exactly the same 11 tracked dirty paths and no SMS-refactor files, baseline backend and LuCI tests have recorded exit results, sms-read.js and sms-send.js hashes are recorded, and a read-only router probe using Windows OpenSSH to 192.168.1.200 with an isolated temporary known-host file confirms rpcd ucode support and target command availability or records an exact blocker. Do not edit product files, commit, stage, push, or change router state. Evidence must be written under D:/Code/Git/ImmortalWrt-C8-660-CI/.omo/start-work/T0 with exact commands, sanitized outputs, path lists, hashes, test exits, rpcd/ucode/shell/jq availability, and cleanup receipt.

successCriteria.scenario: From the main Git Bash checkout, create or verify the linked worktree at D:/Code/Git/ImmortalWrt-C8-660-SMS-Refactor on refs/heads/codex/sms-forward-refactor at commit f97b925d9808ee34b3660ae122df024ebaa31bdd; run sha256sum on C:/Users/Administrator/AppData/Local/Temp/c8-sms-user-worktree.patch and require exactly 543ab772ad16f879dfdcabe3a5963ab3cc7c1aa5ba2dd47ea0799dc5818b4d05; run git apply --check then git apply in the external worktree; finally run git status --porcelain=v1 and git diff --name-only there and compare them byte-for-byte with the main checkout 11 tracked dirty paths. PASS is the exact branch/HEAD, expected patch hash and successful apply, exactly 11 external tracked modified paths, no untracked SMS-refactor files, and a non-empty transcript artifact.
successCriteria.expectedEvidence: .omo/start-work/T0/evidence.md contains exact commands, exit codes, sanitized stdout, patch hash, branch and HEAD, main and external path lists, and apply receipt; the exact external path is recorded in the artifact.

successCriteria.scenario: In the validated external worktree, execute bash Scripts/TestC8SmsForward.sh and bash Scripts/TestC8SmsForwardLuCI.sh as separate commands, capture each stdout and stderr and exit code, and execute sha256sum patches/files/www/luci-static/resources/view/c8modem/sms-read.js patches/files/www/luci-static/resources/view/c8modem/sms-send.js into the requested read-send.sha256 artifact. Then use Windows OpenSSH ssh.exe to 192.168.1.200 with a newly created isolated known-host file and read-only remote commands that report command -v and version/support probes for rpcd, ucode, sh/ash, jq, sms_tool, curl, timeout, mkdir, mv, and the rpcd ucode module path; sanitize credentials, SMS bodies, sender and recipient identifiers, and any secret-bearing output. PASS is recorded test exits, two non-empty hash lines, and either positive rpcd-ucode plus command availability output or an exact blocker with command exit, sanitized stderr, and no router writes.
successCriteria.expectedEvidence: .omo/start-work/T0/evidence.md cites non-empty backend-test.log and luci-test.log or combined test transcript with exact exit codes, the two-line .omo/start-work/T0/read-send.sha256, router-probe.log with sanitized SSH/support/availability output or an exact blocker, and the temporary-known-host cleanup receipt.

successCriteria.scenario: After all T0 operations and cleanup, run git -C D:/Code/Git/ImmortalWrt-C8-660-CI status --porcelain=v1, git -C D:/Code/Git/ImmortalWrt-C8-660-CI diff --cached --quiet, git -C D:/Code/Git/ImmortalWrt-C8-660-SMS-Refactor diff --cached --quiet, git worktree list --porcelain, and a filesystem test that the isolated temporary known-host path no longer exists. PASS is no product-file diff created by this task, no staged changes or commit or push, original 11 tracked modifications preserved, external status limited to those same 11 paths, the requested worktree retained, and the known-host and temp probe cleanup receipt recorded.
successCriteria.expectedEvidence: .omo/start-work/T0/evidence.md ends with a cleanup receipt naming every temporary path and exact removal command, records the final main and external status and staged-state exits, and states the worktree remains registered; no credential or SMS content appears.
